summary: Tested Vetrina pubblica, Trova Specialista, public /medico/{slug}, and Portal Panoramica ('In parole semplici' + doctor card), backend and frontend, at 390/768/1280/1440/1920. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (showcase GET/PUT, validation, unpublish hides page and directory entry, photo/cover upload to Emergent object storage, replacing or deleting an image makes the old file 404, gif->400, >8MB->400, bad kind->404, RBAC, public directory/slug/unknown->404, portal simple: available, cached, 404 when not linked, 403 for doctor, cache cleared by doctor PATCH and regenerated in ~4.5s). Frontend: all flows work end to end: greeting 'Buon pomeriggio, Giulia', kid chip, next appointment, simple box with diagnosi/todo/when/glossary and tooltips on hover and focus, Scrivi -> /portale/messaggi, Prenota -> booking dialog with Aurora and Dott.ssa Foti preselected, Vetrina link -> dialog, search filtering and empty state, dialog book -> booking with doctor preselected, public page without login plus book redirect plus missing slug, editor live preview, uploads, save -> public page, unpublish -> missing, copy link. Fixed 2 CSS bugs myself (directory avatar hidden under cover; editor overflowing at 390px). One design issue left for main agent: service-name input in the Vetrina editor is unusably narrow on desktop. Founder data restored: published=true, bio/tagline empty, no photo/cover, the 4 original services.

minor.issue: If object storage fails (get_object raises), the error is not caught and becomes a 500. Should catch it and return 503/404 as the upload path does.
Reads the whole body before checking size (no streaming limit). 8MB+10B is correctly rejected with 400, but very large bodies are still fully loaded into memory.
N+1 pattern: ensure_slug plus an extra find_one plus full() for every doctor on each request. Fine now (1 network doctor) but will not scale; also performs writes inside a public GET.

The slug only exists after ensure_slug runs (doctor opens the Vetrina or someone hits the directory). Until then the portal doctor card hides the 'Vedi la Vetrina' link. Consider generating the slug at doctor activation.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the avatar was painted under the cover band because the cover is position:relative and the content is not. Added 'relative z-10' to the content wrapper; verified the avatar is on top at 390/768/1440.

FIXED by testing agent: at 390px the editor column grew to 486px (the grid auto column took the min-content of the nowrap link) and was clipped on the right, hiding the Copia/Apri buttons and the input edges. Added grid-cols-1 (minmax(0,1fr)); verified at 390/768.

NOT FIXED: on desktop (xl two-column layout) the service name input is unusable: 26px wide at 1280, 97px at 1440, 109px at 1920, so names like 'Prima visita' are cut off. Cause: sm:grid-cols-[1fr_90px_100px_auto] inside the narrow left column. Suggest putting the name on its own full row (or name + delete), with duration and price on a second row at xl, e.g. 'xl:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto]' with the name spanning all columns.

issues: A leftover support banner 'TEST_ risposta di prova' from a previous iteration is shown below the overview (test data, not a code bug)
AI glossary terms are sometimes everyday words ('Crescita regolare') rather than real medical terms. Prompt quality only, optional.

action_items: Fix the service row layout in ShowcaseSection.jsx so the service name input is readable at >=1280px (currently 26-109px wide)
Optional: catch storage errors in GET /api/public/files/{id}
Optional: generate the showcase slug at doctor activation so the portal 'Vedi la Vetrina' link always appears
Optional: remove the TEST_ support reply notice for the demo parent
critical_code_review_comments: showcase.py public directory does writes (ensure_slug) inside a GET and is N+1
visible() does not check in_network, so a non-network doctor's /medico/{slug} page is publicly reachable even though it is excluded from the directory. Confirm this is intended.
SpecialistsDirectory onBook preselects children[0] even when another child is linked to the chosen doctor. Acceptable, but could pick the child linked to that doctor.
PortalOverview greeting uses the client clock (fine). The next appointment filter includes today's already-past times (backend filters by date only).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; 1 open desktop layout issue in the editor)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test images uploaded then deleted; TEST_ bio/tagline/service removed; founder showcase restored (published=true, empty bio/tagline, no images, 4 original services). Aurora's latest consultation was re-PATCHed with an identical note to test cache invalidation, so its simple cache was regenerated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0 (pytest.ini enables xdist; the module fixtures restore founder state). /login is the landing page; the login form appears on /app or /portale directly. Only the founder (tiziana-foti) is in the network directory; the cardiologist is not. Playwright screenshots must use .jpg paths when quality is set.
